description: 3D concrete frame analysis and report with YJK
message: Use YJK to run 3D static analysis and generate a report for a 2-story 3D reinforced concrete frame with two 6m bays in global X, one 5m bay in global Y, 3.6m story height, fixed column bases, C30 concrete, HRB400 reinforcement, 500mm × 500mm columns, 300mm × 600mm beams, and a 12kN/m2 downward floor load on each story.

assertions.description: The model must be a genuine spatial 3-D concrete frame with nodes on at least two distinct global Y-coordinate planes. The report must faithfully reflect the current YJK analysis artifact, contain no contradictory numerical value, and make no unsupported structural-safety or code-compliance claim.

engineeringSpecification:
Use these complete analysis-property records exactly in every mode; they are not placeholders and need no clarification. Use only the user task to classify the structure, but include these properties in parameter extraction. Do not create an explicit self-weight load or duplicate a converted load; an analysis provider may apply its configured member self-weight internally. Reconstruct geometry, topology, supports, and load placement from the task.
